name: Tempester 1.5.3.0 — NRPN
summary: Adds NRPN control of the sound parameters, both ways.

additions: Sound parameters (0 to 126, and the Osc 3 / Osc 4 sample) can be set live from MIDI with NRPN: the selected pad on Remote Pad IN, the Synth Sound on Synth IN.
Turning a knob on the panel sends the matching NRPN on Remote Pad OUT.

description: 1.5.2.0 plus NRPN reception (0-126 sound parameters, 156/157 Osc 3/4 sample; selected pad on Remote Pad IN, Synth Sound on Synth IN) and NRPN emission on Remote Pad OUT when a knob is turned (patches n°9a, 9b). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
